audit.scope: P01/G01 Must and artifact requirements; P01-U10/U11 implementation was not started.

current_status.reason: Candidate ZCode interaction is not integrated or independently tested yet. P01-U06 is running; U07-U11 are not started. Do not mark G01 pass from U02 or U05.

classification.plan_statement: Frozen v1.1 plan says P01/G01 requires verifiable identity assets, a runnable primary interaction, honest failure, and native ZCode Runtime still working when the extension is disabled.
classification.source_fact: Pinned ZCode CLI/TUI ordinary input uses sendInput; slash/background compact uses submitPrompt. At the audit snapshot, U06 host.ts wraps submitPrompt/resume/compact/readAdmissionFailures but forwards sendInput through its generic facade.
classification.recommendation: At P01, select and name one existing ZCode user-entry surface. Recommended minimum is the existing CLI/TUI ordinary chat input; use its actual sendInput path. Do not build P10 desktop/Live2D features to prove P01.
not_run: This audit did not launch ZCode, the Xiadie candidate, DSH, or a model.
No current candidate smoke, candidate no-Key/no-DSH/offline test, P01-U10 integration run, or P01-U11 gate run was executed.
Current U06 sendInput behavior is a source inspection only; the candidate UI path remains NOT_RUN.
U06 in-progress native.integration.test.mjs was inspected as source only and was not executed during this audit.

minimum_p01_candidate.boundary: A runnable isolated candidate using the pinned existing ZCode Runtime plus the accepted P01 assets and the integrated U06-U09 code; no standalone product window, Live2D model, tray, or installer is required.

required_evidence.criterion: Pin ZCode commit, Xiadie candidate commit/build, enabled extension state, persona asset version/hash, packet/schema/prompt hashes, and test profile/data root. Show the approved fixed identity is what the candidate Hook actually injects.

Send one ordinary user message through the selected existing ZCode input surface, show the final response in that surface, and correlate it to the runtime turn/Hook receipt. A direct host.submitPrompt call or a slash command alone is insufficient evidence for ordinary UI input.

In the same candidate path, execute exactly one allowlisted read-only operation against a synthetic fixture. Retain input/turn/tool ids, fixture hash, one completion receipt, and the final response; verify there was no write side effect.

Exercise a read-only tool failure and a cancellation/recovery path. The visible result and event/receipt evidence must say failed, cancelled, or incomplete; no success/final-complete claim may appear without successful evidence.
With the same pinned ZCode source and isolated profile, disable the extension and prove the native Runtime still accepts an ordinary turn. Record the before/after config hashes and host result.
On the actual candidate, start a fresh no-Key profile, reach local settings/onboarding, and record zero provider/model requests. Never include credential values in logs.

On the actual candidate, run without DSH installed or on PATH and record that no DSH process/request was attempted and the P01 ZCode path remains usable. The current U02 guard does not itself prove this process-level condition.

Point an isolated candidate profile at the existing loopback-only 503 fixture. Send an ordinary user message and retain the visible unavailable/error state plus runtime receipt; prove the turn is not represented as successful.

Label mock, actual ZCode Runtime, authorized paid-model, and distribution-package evidence separately. Mock evidence cannot stand in for the candidate Runtime. P01 may mark package testing NOT_RUN when no P01 installer artifact exists.

interaction_path.frozen_plan_choice: The v1.1 P01 plan says existing ZCode and primary interaction but does not select CLI versus Desktop. P10 later owns the formal product desktop and fixed Live2D.
interaction_path.recommended_p01_choice: Existing ZCode CLI/TUI ordinary chat input as the smallest P01 host surface; this avoids inventing a P10 interface while still testing a real user entry.
interaction_path.source_semantics: The pinned CLI TUI delegates ordinary user input to activeApp.sendInput when available. The pinned server operation also calls record.app.sendInput for ordinary content; slash/background compact uses submitPrompt.
interaction_path.suitable_proof: Drive the actual selected input surface and record entered text, rendered final text, turn/input ids, Hook admission/receipt, and tool receipt. A headless submitPrompt smoke remains useful as a lower-level Runtime check, but cannot prove this interaction route.
interaction_path.current_gap: Current unaccepted U06 host.ts snapshot does not guard sendInput. Its native integration test source uses host.submitPrompt for mock read, disabled-extension, and fail-closed cases; those test definitions are not execution evidence and do not prove the ordinary UI route. Inference: the selected UI path must be supported or remain a gate blocker until U10.

minimum_contents: Review every accepted implementation result and bind the report to the exact candidate commit/build and asset hashes.
Run success, failure, cancel/recovery, and extension-disabled paths; report mock, actual Runtime, paid model, and package evidence as separate classes.
Independently record scope, permission, fact, and failure negative cases; keep unresolved critical cases blocking.
Record commands, cwd, exit codes, outputs/hashes, limitations, and rollback.
Accept only after U10 and all P01 implementation units are accepted.
Re-run the actual candidate smoke plus no-Key, no-DSH, and offline degradation cases against the exact candidate.
Freeze version scope and source/code/prompt/schema/asset hashes and support limits; explicitly mark pass or blocked.
Keep remote tag/upload/publish outside this gate unless separately authorized.

actual_evidence: Accepted U02 reuse decision selects the pinned native ZCode Runtime/Loop with bounded Xiadie Core/Hook.

still_missing: Accepted U06 product Hook integration and proof that the chosen ordinary message path uses the bounded Xiadie gate.

must_requirements.title: 先查现成、再试、后最小实现
actual_evidence: U02 pins the approved reuse decision and a 241-file SHA-256/git-blob manifest with zero mismatches.
still_missing: U11 must bind that decision to the exact integrated candidate and its source/asset hashes.

must_requirements.title: 多会话、消息操作与流式恢复
must_requirements.p01_slice: For P01, require one ordinary user turn plus the U10 failure/cancel/recovery checks. Full session/message management belongs to later planned work, including P02 and P10; P01 is not a reason to build that UI.
actual_evidence: U02 exercised lower-level Runtime/Loop paths and separately launched the existing Desktop for no-Key settings.
still_missing: No accepted candidate ordinary-input UI turn or rendered response.
No candidate stream cancellation/recovery or event-to-final-result proof.
U02 Desktop driver only navigates entry/settings and tests local preference persistence; it does not send a chat message.

must_requirements.title: 模型配置、能力矩阵和降级
actual_evidence: U02 no-Key control-plane and actual Desktop no-Key/settings attempts passed with zero model requests.
U02 exercised two official model IDs in four earlier calls; backend independence was not proven.
still_missing: U08 candidate configuration/credential isolation and U09 evaluation are not started.
The U02 loopback 503 endpoint was an egress fixture; its Desktop driver did not send a chat, so it does not prove visible offline degradation.
No candidate no-DSH result is recorded.
must_requirements.not_run: Candidate no-Key/no-DSH/offline behavior and candidate model-route result.

must_requirements.title: 单轮来源分层与token预算
actual_evidence: Accepted U05 separates instruction/state/evidence/content, pins source_refs/scope/version, validates exact shapes, and measures a UTF-8 byte upper bound for the packet.
still_missing: Actual candidate Hook-to-model integration and visible proof that the right source/version was injected on the chosen turn.
U05 explicitly does not measure tokenizer tokens or host-native system/project prompt accounting; the gate must retain that limitation rather than claim a complete token budget.
must_requirements.not_run: Candidate prompt source projection and any tokenizer-level measurement.

u02_reuse.accepted_scope: U02 is an accepted spike/reuse decision, not P01/G01 acceptance.

best_existing_parts.reuse: Reuse the isolated child environment, fresh home/data/temp directories, production-file SHA-256 before/after snapshot, no-secret logging, model-request count, and run manifest pattern.

Reuse the actual pinned ZCode Desktop launcher, fresh profile, 127.0.0.1 ephemeral 503 endpoint, listener baseline, dynamic inspector/CDP checks, and artifact manifest pattern if Desktop is the selected host.

Reuse Playwright against the actual ZCode UI and its DOM/settings assertions; add the one ordinary chat send, final-result assertion, read-only receipt, error/cancel assertions only for the candidate run.
Reuse the network guard and loopback allowlist. Add the smallest process observation needed for no-DSH; current guard records network/utility forks but does not prove no DSH child process.
Reuse the no-Key ZCode control-plane probe for startup/settings reachability; it is not a substitute for the candidate UI/Runtime smoke.

minimal_reuse_plan: Keep accepted U02 files/evidence as the immutable baseline; make the U11 runner parameterize the exact candidate build/plugin path and isolated profile.
Use separate fresh profiles for candidate success, no-Key, no-DSH, and offline cases. Keep dynamic loopback ports and production hash checks.

For no-Key, assert settings reachable and model request count is zero. For no-DSH, omit DSH from PATH/config and capture process/request evidence. For offline, use the existing 503 server and assert a visible failed/unavailable result with no success receipt.

Drive the selected normal user-input control so the real sendInput route, candidate Hook, tool receipt, and final UI result are connected in one evidence chain. Record screenshot only as visual evidence; DOM/transcript plus runtime receipts prove function.
The current U02 Desktop no-Key evidence and U02 mock loop remain pre-candidate evidence; both must be rerun or explicitly referenced only as baseline, not passed forward as U11 candidate results.
existing_gaps: U02 Desktop summary is no-Key/settings persistence with zero model requests; the driver never submits chat input.
U02 accepts visual screenshot verification as NOT_RUN.
U02 no-Key script and Desktop guard do not assert absence of DSH process launch.
U02 mock/model routes do not use the integrated P01 candidate; acceptance says scope U02 only.

The current U06 native.integration.test.mjs defines mock read, disabled-extension, and fail-closed tests through host.submitPrompt; its source has no sendInput UI test, and this audit did not execute it.

P10.conclusion: P10 is explicitly the formal desktop stage: one main window, tray, cards/readable status, and fixed Live2D. None is a P01 installer or G01 criterion.

P16.conclusion: P16-U04 requires a real artifact hash check and clean-environment download/install/run/uninstall verification. The frozen v1.1 sources do not name NSIS or any installer technology. P01 does not require NSIS; leave package-tech choice to P16.

NSIS.finding: No NSIS requirement is stated in the frozen v1.1 planning sources. P01 candidate can be an isolated runnable build/profile. P16 requires installer validation, with installer mechanism unspecified.
